# 金剛經疏

**ID:** T2738
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 般若部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2738

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A second **anonymous one-juan *Vajracchedikā* commentary** recovered from the **Dūnhuáng cache** and preserved as T85 no. 2738. Distinct from but companion to [KR6c0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0109) (T85 no. 2737) and [KR6c0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0111) (T85 no. 2739). Authorship not preserved. The surviving fragment treats the *kṣānti-pāramitā* (forbearance-perfection) section of the sūtra. *notBefore* / *notAfter* set very broadly (**600–900**) consistent with the Dūnhuáng-corpus dating range. Catalog dynasty 唐.

**Abstract**

The surviving fragment opens on the *rěnrǔ pōluómì* 忍辱波羅蜜 (forbearance perfection) section of the sūtra. The commentator deploys a striking gendered-political typology of *forces*: *gù nǚrén yǐ chēn wéi lì, yù yǒu suǒ suǒ bì xiān chēn gù; guówáng yǐ jiāoháo wéi lì; luóhàn yǐ jīngjìn wéi lì; zhūfó yǐ dàbēi wéi lì; bǐqiū yǐ rěn wéi lì* 故女人以嗔為力，欲有所索必先嗔故；國王以嬌豪為力；羅漢以精進為力；諸佛以大悲為力；比丘以忍為力 ("women take anger as their force, since seeking something they must first anger; kings take haughtiness as their force; arhats take diligence as their force; buddhas take great compassion as their force; *bhikṣus* take forbearance as their force"). The commentator then cites the *Yíjiàojīng* 遺教經, the *Qīfó jì* 七佛偈, and other authoritative sources on *kṣānti*, before specifying that the *Vajracchedikā*'s *rěn* is to be understood as **non-arising-dharmas-forbearance** (*wúshēng fǎrěn* 無生法忍 — the *anutpattika-dharma-kṣānti* characteristic of non-retrogressing bodhisattvas). The work belongs to the same Dūnhuáng anonymous-commentary cluster as [KR6c0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0109) and [KR6c0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0111).
